cases.prompt: I need a reusable Flutter dependency-graph explainer with a selection detail, camera controls and a paused first render. Give the concrete scaffold and verification route for an owned output directory.
criteria: Use repository-owned scaffold/example instead of an orphan scratch template.
Use one ECS world with typed selectors/actions.
Verify actual pixels and effects in addition to contracts.
Give supported scaffold options and distinguish Flutter executable from SDK root.

cases.prompt: A remote data revision must update my Flutter preview while I keep typing in another macOS app. Outline the update and verification contract without shifting focus.
criteria: Use resident apply with requestId and expectedRevision.
Preserve camera/selection/runtime identity and avoid recompilation for data.
Use background/nonactivating policy and one injected frame request.
Keep native pixel/idle failures unqualified and separate effect from delivery.

cases.prompt: Make an inline HTML visualization in this conversation explaining exponential decay. I have no Flutter host. Which rendering path should be used?
criteria: Route to visualize rather than Flutter scaffolding.
Do not claim an ordinary Flutter build is an inline HTML fragment.
Choose a useful quantitative plot and a parameter control.
Avoid spinning up an unnecessary browser/Flutter engine.

cases.prompt: Embed two independent Flutter visualizations in my existing web page. I already own an action catalog. Update one scene, remove it, then remount it without changing the other. Give the lifecycle and addressing contract.
criteria: Use public multi-view lifecycle with one engine and per-view worlds.
Address state/actions and preserve the host catalog; refuse ambiguity/collisions.
Unregister/dispose removed viewer and leave surviving runtime unchanged.
Use stable per-view checkpoint identity and distinguish new world from retained checkpoint.

cases.prompt: I want every new Flutter visualization and code edit visible in milliseconds. What mechanism should we use, and what would prove that it is fast?
criteria: Separate resident data updates from code edits and cold preparation.
Reuse retained Flutter/Oka development compiler sessions before proposing replacement engines.
Separate compiler, app state, scene readiness, completed frame and independent presentation clocks.
Do not promise millisecond cold startup or JS superiority without equivalent measured cohorts.
